items.title: What Changed In Marvell's Story?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 201% in the past year, against 17.7% for the S&P 500. Investors value it as an AI data center chip company at 85.6 times earnings, versus 22.1 for the S&P 500. Investors paying that multiple are counting on data center growth staying fast. Management used to tell a second growth story too, and it no longer leads with that story. So what did Marvell's management stop leading with.

items.title: Is Cerebras' Next Big Thing Already Here?
items.summary: Cerebras Systems (CBRS) sells AI hardware and rents out computing power through its own cloud. The shares trade 37.3% below their 52-week high, even though management raised its 2026 revenue forecast in August. Cerebras still reports a loss. Anyone buying the shares today is paying for growth still to come. So how much of that growth has Cerebras already signed.

items.title: What Is The True Hidden Price Of Marvell Stock?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock, at $263.27 a share (September 29, 2026 close) and a market value of about $231 billion, trades at 80 times its past twelve months of adjusted earnings per share. That is steep for one year of profit, but Marvell's sales are growing fast, so the next two years matter more. What, then, is the real price of Marvell stock once you count the profit expected in those years.

items.title: Prediction: Rambus Could Be a Quiet Winner From Exploding AI Demand
items.summary: Rambus sits far below its 52-week high while AI server builders keep adding racks that depend on its chips. Whether the stock is a overlooked opportunity or a value trap comes down to a few critical revenue milestones in the quarters ahead.

items.title: When AMD's CEO and the Chart Say the Same Thing, Pay Attention
items.summary: On August 4, 2026, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) guided third-quarter revenue to about $13 billion, above its $11.2 billion second-quarter guide. AMD stock has gained 25.4% since the August 3 close, the day before that release, against 0.9% for the S&P 500. Many rallies have no new company numbers behind them, so one backed by a higher forecast is worth a look. Below we look at AMD's new guidance, its share price trend, and what could lift the stock further.

items.title: Better AI Chip Stock to Buy Today: Broadcom vs. Marvell
items.summary: Marvell stock has greatly outperformed Broadcom's this year, but will that continue?

items.title: ASML Holding N.V. vs. Marvell Technology: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: ASML commands a near-monopoly on chip-making equipment with a 29% net margin, while Marvell surged 42% in revenue but trades at a steeper valuation.

items.title: Can GLOBALFOUNDRIES (GFS) Justify Its Price On Future Cash Flow?
items.summary: GLOBALFOUNDRIES has climbed 34.1% over the past year, bringing the focus onto whether the cash the business can generate really supports that move. With the share price at US$47.86 as of the last close, the question now is how that market tag compares with what its cash flows suggest the stock is worth.
